summary: Amanda controlled send (Issue #29): outbound_email_drafts becomes the durable automatic-reply receipt store for draft_kind 'amanda_auto_reply'. The status CHECK gains claimed, draft_created, draft_ready, send_requested, unverified and failed (draft, sent, discarded unchanged); 15 nullable or defaulted lease / Graph-handle / audit columns; a unique claim index for this kind across every status; sweep and rate-cap indexes. Additive: no existing row is changed. The feature stays off until AMANDA_AUTO_REPLY=on.

expected_changes: Replaces outbound_email_drafts_status_check: same name, the existing values draft/sent/discarded plus claimed, draft_created, draft_ready, send_requested, unverified, failed.

Adds nullable columns lease_token (uuid), lease_expires_at, claimed_at, graph_draft_id, sent_internet_message_id, conversation_id, objective_id (uuid), inbound_email_id (uuid), send_requested_at, verified_at, escalated_at, last_error, policy (jsonb), plus attempts and verify_checks (integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0).
Adds uq_outbound_drafts_amanda_auto_reply UNIQUE (source_email_ref, draft_kind) WHERE draft_kind = 'amanda_auto_reply' (one automatic reply per inbound message, every status).
Adds idx_outbound_drafts_auto_reply_open (status, lease_expires_at) and idx_outbound_drafts_auto_reply_rate (to_email, created_at DESC), both partial on draft_kind = 'amanda_auto_reply'.
No existing outbound_email_drafts row is changed; no other table is touched; GRANTs from 327 still apply.
